verdict.rationale: Hatchet has dedicated self-hosting docs explicitly stating you can run your own Hatchet Control Plane instance, with a full self-hosting guide and 'Run Hatchet yourself' section, and is open-source on GitHub. Missing for 10: independent hands-on confirmation of a successful self-hosted deployment (community discussion focuses on managed/product feedback rather than self-host experience) and more detail on infra requirements/HA in self-hosted mode.
